name: test_onoff
description: Bare minimum: open hand enables the plugin, fist bypasses it. Every other Harmony Engine setting is left to you.
_why_hand_openness: Not open_hand/closed_fist: those need exactly 5 and exactly 0 fingers, so a half-relaxed hand matches neither and the state latches. hand_openness is continuous with a threshold at 0.5, so it is always definitively one or the other.

mappings._target: Reaper's FX Bypass for Harmony Engine, or its Wet. Both sit in the Param list. Flip "invert" if it comes out backwards.
mappings.label: Effect On
